KEYWORDS

Inhalation Toxicology - plasma nicotine - plasma cotinine

SUMMARY

Study TRD ATS 013 is a 28-day inhalation study comparing the responses in animals exposed to sidetream smoke from test and reference cigarettes, in both 85 and \(100\mathrm{mm}\) configurations. The experimental protocol is attached, along with the list of signatures formally approving this protocol.

The approved protocol defines three sets of contractors to be used in the completion of the work: this contract will be for work performed by Battelle (Richland, WA) on plasma nicotine and cotinine. The work should be completed October 1988.
No formal estimate has been made by Battelle to cover the work in the protocol. However, based on earlier work, the figure of $ 40,000 should cover the work with an adequate reserve. A formal estimate has been requested from Battelle.

NOTES

RJRT has already entered into several similar contracts with Battelle and the latest such contract should serve as a template for the contract required in study TRD ATS 013.
